title: Expression sheet
buttonTitle: Draw bust-shot expressions from the front view and collect them into a sheet
intro: Draw bust-shot expressions one at a time from the front of the main illustration. Draw "Neutral" first to set the framing; the rest line up with it. Adopting one only adds it to the sheet and never replaces the main illustration.
needFront: Draw a main illustration first, then you can draw expressions.
staleHint: The main illustration has changed since this was drawn. You can redraw it.
customNotePlaceholder: e.g. one corner of the mouth up, eyes narrowed
allHint: Autopilot draws them one by one and Design QA picks the best image for each. You can stop any time.
allNeedsDirect: To draw them all automatically, set the drawing method to "AIDOL draws" in Settings. You can also press "Draw" on each one.
faceHint: Draw a set of bust-shot expressions from the front view
limit: An expression sheet can hold up to 24 expressions.
allHintStale: Autopilot draws them one by one (ones marked "Old design" are redrawn from the new main illustration) and Design QA picks the best image for each. You can stop any time.
